text_to_image_prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Generate ONE completely new fictional adult male character from this written casting brief. This is an original casting design, not an edit and not a recreation of any prior photographed person. Face anatomy and proportions must follow the NEW facial design below. Retain the subtle personality of the archetype without defaulting to a generic handsome actor face. Highly realistic portrait with genuine everyday individuality, natural asymmetry, pores and fine vellus hair, no beauty filter. Bright soft frontal studio light, generous fill, low shadows, subtle restrained optical halation, realistic 50mm perspective, shallow depth of field but both eyes sharply focused. Solid pure white #FFFFFF seamless background across entire frame, no gradient, no scene, no props. Vertical 2:3 composition, complete head with white breathing room above hair, entire shoulders and arms included horizontally, half-body down to waist, upright head and torso facing camera, direct eye contact, arms relaxed. Natural clothing texture. No text, no logo, no watermark, no collage. Output one independent full-resolution photograph. Casting brief: A 29-year-old East Asian man with a close crew cut and translucent smoke-gray rectangular glasses, plain black tee, solid everyday build. NEW facial design: long trapezoid face with heavier lower jaw, close-set hooded eyes, fine high arched brows, long broad-bridge nose, narrow mouth with full lower lip, slight chin cleft and uneven skin texture. Neutral friendly gaze.
reproduction_note: 文字可复用构图、气质与质感，但随机采样可能改变脸部细节；未验证仅凭文字可达到近乎一致。需要严格锁脸时请同时使用此图作为身份参考。
